I'll use the release-notes skill and draft ~120 words covering the breaking name split, `--incremental`, and faster Parquet writes.## sqlpipe v2.0

sqlpipe 2.0 ships a cleaner users API, smarter syncs, and faster exports.

**Breaking: `/v2/users` name fields.** The single `name` field is now `first_name` and `last_name`. Update clients and mappings that still send or read `name`, or requests will fail.

**New `--incremental` flag.** Pass `--incremental` to sync only what changed since the last run. Full refreshes stay available; use incremental when you want shorter jobs and less load on the source.

**Parquet writes ~40% faster.** Export pipelines that land on Parquet should finish sooner with no format or schema changes on your side.

Upgrade when you can absorb the users API change; then turn on `--incremental` where it fits and enjoy the quicker Parquet path.
